**Paper:** [link](https://arxiv.org/abs/XXXX.XXXXX) · **Read for:** Topic N, ...

## Claim
One or two sentences: what the paper says is true.

## Method
How they get there: the key idea, model or derivation, in my own words.

## Evidence
What the experiments or proofs actually show, and how strong that is.

## Critique
Assumptions, gaps, what is overclaimed, what is missing.

## What I'd test
One concrete experiment I could run to probe the claim.
